messages:
maya: hey everyone! quick Q: where do I post requests for VPN access, GitHub org invite, and a CI bot in our private team channel? onboarding doc mentions a few places and i want to follow the norm

onboarding-bot: welcome @maya! automated checklist: 1) fill https://redwood.internal/onboard 2) for infra access post in #eng-infra or DM @infra with the Access template 3) hardware/software -> #help

eli: short answers: VPN & GCP -> #eng-infra (public thread). GitHub org invites -> DM your manager and cc #eng-infra so we can add you to the right team slug. CI bot -> create a ticket in #eng-infra with subject: "Bot invite - <team>" and include channel name + minimal permissions

maya: thanks! any etiquette for posting keys or personal emails?

it-support: do NOT paste private keys in public channels. For SSH keys: post to #eng-infra but start the message with `[SSH KEY]` and include only the public key. For emails/GitHub invites use corporate email only

eli: extra norm: post access requests in the channel once (one message) instead of spamming multiple pings. If you need privacy, ask in the thread to move to a private ticket. Use :white_check_mark: reaction when issue resolved so infra folks don't have to chase

onboarding-bot: pro tip: to get the calendar bot and onboarding reminders DM `onboard subscribe`. For joining community channels, add a short reason e.g., "joining infra team for onboarding" so owners approve faster

maya: perfect, i'm also curious where to put my intro bio and which channels avoid @channel pings

elI: intro = #new-hires (one short paragraph: role, timezone, team, fun fact). Avoid @channel for routine asks. Use @here only if blockers during your core hours. And please don't invite external bots into private channels without infra sign-off

maya: awesome, posting intro now. thanks all! :wave:
